gates.pass_when: Audition side hashes match current locked request manifest.
Candidates compared at matched loudness with music/reverb off.
Selected candidate materially improves after one precise note without breaking P51/P53.
Competence + humanity + hidden cost coexist; no maternal/seductive/monotone fail.
Charisma + agency + private fracture coexist; no helpless/possessive fail.
Naomi/Eli have extra attention without forcing romance; target remains privately important/professionally constrained.
Cal/Talia do not telegraph guilt and remain professionally credible.
Threat is human, intelligible, replay-consistent, non-supernatural and non-identifying.
Finalists remain intelligible and distinct on headphones, mono and phone.
Naomi/Eli pass 8–10 minute long-form test before season lock.

pilot_lock_rule: Role score >=88, no hard fail, direction-change PASS; Naomi/Eli additionally pair-gate PASS.
season_lock_rule: Pilot lock + E01–E03 performed evidence + long-form fatigue PASS.
